messages.subject: Checked in docs for rmr 1.3
parts:
Hi, 
I just checked in some docs in the 1.3 branch, check out 

https://github.com/RevolutionAnalytics/RHadoop/blob/rmr-1.3/rmr/pkg/docs/

The first thing is that all docs there are present in three versions, Rmd (R markdown), md and html. The first is the primary version and changes can only be made therein, the second is directly viewable on github and the third can be opened in any browser upon downloading it. The transformation is made with  the package knitr. There is no R code in the Rmds, whenever necessary it is included from files in the tests directory, subdivided into knitr chunks. This is not necessary with Rmd but allows to have all the code tested with R CMD check and reused in different documents. The three docs are
  • A compatibility chart
  • A "what's new" document
  • An intro to the vectorized features of the new API
Please take a look and let me know your thoughts.


Antonio
